Then integral q=1, q is C1, J=1, S=4u/(1-u^2) on the moving positive support, E[S]=-integral qprime=0, and E[S^2]=15 integral_{-1}^1 u^2 du=10. Thus the score formula holds with finite variance and no boundary contribution despite moving support. Replaced only the false necessity claim by sufficiency; all positive hypotheses/conclusions are retained. Proof 2.1 now explicitly uses the weighted supremum, with a measurable version set to zero on the common exceptional null set, to justify domination by 2G.
